blocks.text: The AICTE Idea Lab is an initiative by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) to foster innovation, creativity, and hands-on learning in technical institutions across India. It serves as a maker space and innovation hub where students can develop prototypes, work on real-world problems, and enhance their practical skills.
Key features of AICTE Idea Lab:

items.text: Provides modern tools and equipment like 3D printers, laser cutters, and IoT kits.
Encourages experiential learning through hands-on projects.
Supports entrepreneurial ventures by offering mentorship and funding opportunities.
Promotes multidisciplinary collaboration among students, faculty, and industry experts.
Helps institutions align with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, emphasizing
Enhances innovation and research culture in colleges.
Bridges the gap between theoretical knowledge and industry needs.
Encourages students to participate in national and international competitions.
